description: Engine sink collapse plus the shared rollout harness. Without the sink, the bare alias corel_weights.std1_weight = `standard.weight_mg` (A1-0001/0002/0003, A6A-0001/0002/0003/0004) would store a list once `standard` is a table. Adds collapse_series() applied to calculated-field results and criterion `observed` only, adds STANDARD_ROWS / STANDARD_ROW_LABEL / as_standard_table() to _common.py (standard_group() is NOT changed here), and creates scripts/standard_tabular_rollout.py part 1 (ROSTER, convert_definition, audit_references, synthesize_inputs, compare_results, check_equivalence). Independent of FEAT-002/003 in code but FEAT-002 and FEAT-003 depend on it.
steps: Read plan.md (Findings 1-6, Decisions, Helper strategy, Before/after evaluation approach) and the two exploration scripts _scan_refs.py and _prototype_equiv.py in d:\RD-instance\GIT\.agents\tasks\std-details-rollout\.

In backend-v2/src/domain/services/calculation/expression.py add a public `collapse_series(value)` right after `class ColumnSeries(list)` (line ~66): a non-empty ColumnSeries returns its first element, an empty one returns EMPTY, anything else is returned unchanged. Do not edit `_resolve`, `_as_number` or `_loose_equal`.

In backend-v2/src/domain/services/calculation/evaluator.py import `collapse_series` (import block lines 30-36), apply it in `_evaluate_field` to `value` before `_apply_rounding` (the line `value = evaluate(field_def.expression or "", scope)`), and in `_evaluate_criteria` to `observed` (`observed = evaluate(criterion.target, scope)`).

Add tests to class TestMultiRowScalarCollapse in backend-v2/tests/calculation/test_evaluator.py (class at line ~644): (a) a calculated field whose whole expression is a bare `tbl.field` over a 2-row table stores row 1 as a scalar, not a list; (b) a criterion whose target is a bare multi-row ref is assessed against row 1; (c) mean/sd/count over the same ref still use both rows.

In backend-v2/scripts/template_definitions/_common.py add `STANDARD_ROWS = {"min": 1, "max": 10, "default": 1}`, `STANDARD_ROW_LABEL = {"format": "STD - {n}"}` and `as_standard_table(group)` (deep copy; singleton -> kind table + rows + rowLabel + drop renderAsTable; table -> unchanged copy; never mutate the input). Leave `standard_group()` untouched in this feature.

Create backend-v2/scripts/standard_tabular_rollout.py part 1 (pure functions, no DB): ROSTER with the 25 entries of the plan.md roster (code, version, expected status, group keys, source kind helper/inline/db-only, module-equality kind equal/drifted/none); convert_definition(defn, keys); audit_references(defn, keys) implementing the allowed-context rule from plan.md (port _scan_refs.py; allow-list only corel_weights.std1_weight = standard.weight_mg); synthesize_inputs(defn, pad_keys=None) (deterministic, port from _prototype_equiv.py); compare_results(old, new, converted_keys) and check_equivalence(old_def, new_def, converted_keys, worksheets) per the comparison rules in plan.md, including the padded-3-row independence check and coverage counts.

Create backend-v2/tests/calculation/test_std_details_tabular_rollout.py part 1: as_standard_table idempotent / non-mutating / drops renderAsTable; convert_definition output passes TemplateDefinition.parse and the empty-input dry run; audit_references flags if(standard.x,...), mean(standard.x), a criterion target, a whole-group ref and accepts arithmetic and round(standard.x, 2); check_equivalence on a hand-built definition with the corel_weights alias is clean only because of the sink.
Run the verification commands, then commit locally: `feat(engine): collapse multi-row series at calculated-field and criterion sinks; add rollout harness`.
acceptance_criteria: `python -m pytest tests/calculation/test_evaluator.py tests/calculation/test_expression.py tests/calculation/test_std_details_tabular_rollout.py -q` passes from backend-v2 in the worktree.
`python -m pytest -q` fails only the 5 known tests listed in context.json.
`git diff` of expression.py shows only the added collapse_series function (no change to _resolve, _as_number, _loose_equal).
check_equivalence over the 25 live definitions read-only (see FEAT-003 dry run, or an ad-hoc call) reports 0 diffs once convert_definition is applied.
findings: Committed e3efcd4 on std-details-rollout (not pushed). Verification: (1) pytest test_evaluator.py test_expression.py test_std_details_tabular_rollout.py -q = 199 passed; (2) seed_test_templates --validate-only exit 0 (38 definitions valid); (3) full pytest -q = 969 passed, 5 failed, exactly the 5 known tests. expression.py diff = only the added collapse_series() (15 lines). Read-only run against live lims.db (mode=ro) of all 25 ROSTER rows (ids/versions/statuses matched the roster): 0 audit_references violations, 0 check_equivalence diffs, every row has non-blank calculated cells in the synthetic run (11 to 510); variants per row 3-7 (empty, synth, N stored worksheets, pad3). Ad-hoc script: .agents/tasks/std-details-rollout/_feat001_live_check.py. API for later steps: scripts/standard_tabular_rollout.py exports STANDARD_KEYS, RosterEntry(code, template_id, version, status, keys, source helper|inline|db, module equal|drifted|none), ROSTER (25 rows, 28 groups: 25 standard + 3 standard_2; 9 equal / 9 drifted / 7 none), convert_definition(defn, keys) (ValueError on missing key or non singleton/table kind), audit_references(defn, keys) -> list[str] (empty = safe), synthesize_inputs(defn, pad_keys=None) -> (ctx, groups), compare_results(old, new, converted_keys) -> [(cell, old, new)], check_equivalence(old_def, new_def, keys, worksheets=[(ctx, groups), ...]) -> EquivalenceReport(.diffs [(variant, cell, old, new)], .variants, .nonblank_calculated, .reportable, .ok, .coverage_ok). _common.py has STANDARD_ROWS, STANDARD_ROW_LABEL, as_standard_table(); standard_group() is untouched (still singleton) so FEAT-002 must change it. Deviations/notes: (a) audit_references walks every string in the definition (not just groups/criteria/resultRef/context/chart/summary), skipping label/limitText/help/description/key/unit, flags unparseable strings that mention a converted key, and flags resultRef pointing into a converted group; the live 25 rows give 0 violations. The bare-alias allow-list is exact: path groups.corel_weights.fields.std1_weight.expression with text 'standard.weight_mg'. (b) The padded rows scale each field by a different factor (1.37/1.91 + 0.07*field index); equal factors left weight/volume ratios unchanged and hid a mean() hazard in my own test. (c) check_equivalence treats an evaluation error as a difference only when old and new errors differ. (d) Tests in test_std_details_tabular_rollout.py build their own singleton definitions and do not call standard_group(), so they survive FEAT-002. TestRoster pins the 25/28/9-9-7 counts. (e) Working-tree files are CRLF (autocrlf=true, index LF); new files were written as CRLF to match.
